about.title: About the Obsidian Flames set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Obsidian Flames is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 11 August 2023. It has 230 cards: 197 in the main set and 33 secret rares. For a master set there are also 176 reverse holos, and 44 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 197 main set cards), the Complete set (all 230 cards), the Master set (406 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (450 cards, adding the 44 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
